newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish brewer Brok seeks IPO price of PLN 24.
newsitem.headline: Polish brewer Brok seeks IPO price of PLN 24.

text.p: Polish brewer Brok SA has priced its planned 287,000-share initial public offering at 24 zlotys each and has sent an issue prospectus to the Polish Securities Commission (KPW), PAP news agency said on Tuesday.
PAP said the subscription should be carried out in mid- April and that the firm would enter the parallel market of the Warsaw bourse in this year's first half.
No one at the firm was immediately available for comment. @
After the issue a subsidiary of Germany's Holsten brewer, AHK Beteiligungsgesellschaft, would have 51 percent of Brok. AHK is jointly owned by Holsten and another German investor, AMS of Hamburg.
Other Brok shareholders include employees, individual investors and state-owned Bank Pekao SA, which the firm said last September would hold nine percent after the public issue.
Brok has said funds from the issue would go toward buying a new brewing plant at the company's headquarters in Koszalin. @
It plans to invest 90 million zlotys over the next three years, more than doubling production from the current 550,000 hectolitres annually.
The brewer now has a three-percent market share.
